text:
Jimmy Fallon didn't hold back(Image: @FallonTonight/x)

Jimmy Fallon was joined by comedian Rose Kelso as they poked fun at Karoline Leavitt following Donald Trump's outburst at a female reporter.

During the Tuesday, June 9, episode of The Tonight Show, the 51-year-old host poked fun at the president and his irritated reaction to questions asked during his Meet the Press interview. Trump ended up storming out of the interview with NBC host Kristen Welker after she asked for proof of his election fraud claims.

Following his critique of the president, Fallon welcomed "Karoline Leavitt," portrayed by comedian Kelso, to the program to account for Trump's combative demeanor. After Fallon thanked Kelso's White House press secretary for appearing, she replied with similar defensiveness to Trump. Fallon wasn't the only comedian to mock Trump, as Jon Stewart branded him a "fragile man baby."

"Oh really? We're going to play that game? Yeah. I think we're done here" Kelso's Leavitt said, removing her microphone and attempting to leave abruptly.

When Fallon stopped her to clarify that he "wasn't trying to be rude," she fired back with another sharp retort, "Oh so I'm just being sensitive? Yeah. Okay, I've had enough of this," once more leaving the scene.

Jimmy Fallon poked fun at Karoline Leavitt(Image: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon)

The host then suggested there must be a "misunderstanding," prompting the pretend Leavitt to respond, "Uh huh. I bet you'd rather have a mister understanding right? That's it. I'm calling it."

Following several similar exchanges, Fallon observed, "I feel like you came into this interview ready to storm out. Are you just trying to avoid my questions?" Kelso's Leavitt replied, "Let me put it this way. Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah," mimicking Britney Spears with a face mic. "This interview is over."

Fallon has yet to receive a response from Trump, who has consistently called for his cancellation in the past, describing the "absolutely NO TALENT" host as someone who will be "gone" eventually.

Leavitt hasn't replied either, given she is currently on maternity leave and away from her White House responsibilities. Early in her absence, Leavitt briefly returned to criticize one of Fallon's colleagues for his comments.

On the morning after the White House Correspondents' Dinner, she assembled the media to condemn political violence and denounce Jimmy Kimmel. She stated his repeated, "completely deranged" attacks on the first family "inspires [viewers] to commit violence."

While Kimmel subsequently labeled her a "psychic lady," she resumed her maternity leave following that press briefing. During the press secretary's absence, White House communications director Steven Cheung will assume responsibility for managing White House communications.

Rose Kelso took on the press secretary role(Image: X)

While Leavitt and Trump haven't commented on Fallon's sketch, fans were loving it. One person posted on X criticizing Trump as they wrote, "He's a child and a nihilistic hoarder."

Someone else added a love heart emoji, while others commented crying laughing emojis. Another viewer impersonated Trump in their response and said, "I am the first loudly booed president. My boos are even louder than every president ever. I am the best president in history being booed so loud!"
